ValidationRule.description: When the Sub Cat = Invoice/Line Item Question or Billing Dispute or PO Maintenance (Purchase Order Add, Update, Remove). this field is mandatory to “Resolve” case #14967
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
OR( AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Global_Service_Case', ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Resolved'), ISPICKVAL( GSC_Category__c , 'Billing & Invoice' ), ISPICKVAL( GSC_Further_Detail__c , '' ), NOT (ISPICKVAL( GSC_Root_Cause__c,'Child Case Task')), OR( ISPICKVAL( GSC_Sub_Category__c , 'Billing Dispute' ), ISPICKVAL( GSC_Sub_Category__c , 'Invoice /Line Item Questions' ), ISPICKVAL( GSC_Sub_Category__c , 'PO Maintenance (Purchase Order Add, Update, Remove)' ), ISPICKVAL( GSC_Sub_Category__c , 'Payment / Allocation Enquiry' )) ),
AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Global_Service_Case', ISPICKVAL( GSC_Category__c , 'Amendment of Customer Details' ), ISPICKVAL( GSC_Further_Detail__c , '' ), ISPICKVAL( GSC_Sub_Category__c , 'Company Name Changes' ), ISPICKVAL( GSC_Root_Cause__c , 'Customer Change Request' ) ) ,
AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Global_Service_Case', ISPICKVAL( GSC_Category__c , 'Contract Issues' ), ISPICKVAL( GSC_Further_Detail__c , '' ), ISPICKVAL( GSC_Sub_Category__c , 'Contract Discrepancy' ), ISPICKVAL( GSC_Root_Cause__c , 'Non adherence to process by IM' ) ), AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Global_Service_Case', ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Resolved'), ISPICKVAL( GSC_Category__c , 'Reporting' ), ISPICKVAL( GSC_Further_Detail__c , '' ), OR( ISPICKVAL( GSC_Sub_Category__c , 'Customer Details' ), ISPICKVAL( GSC_Sub_Category__c , 'Billing & Invoice' ), ISPICKVAL( GSC_Sub_Category__c , 'Contract Related' ), ISPICKVAL( GSC_Sub_Category__c , 'Order Related' )) )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Further Detail field should be Required.
